body:
One FIT-only pooled author BLA28 fit and 384 causal development forecasts, with unchanged recurrent checkpoints.

Independent audit PASS: all four continuation conditions hold. BLA standardized RMSE is 0.09573; VARX96 remains the stronger linear reference at 0.05830; recurrent feedback is 0.04290. This does not reproduce the authors' periodic score or establish architectural novelty. The nonlinear NL-LFR and untouched scenario shift remain pending.

The archive includes the initial and final fitted models, all new request inputs and forecasts, optimizer trace, qualification failures and successes, independent audit, prior comparison evidence, source code and licenses. Original measurements and virtual environments are excluded. The manifest contains per-file hashes; the receipt contains the archive SHA-256.

Read the report at https://github.com/kw2828/OpenJev/blob/main/research/fsm-author-bla-results.md
name: FIT-only author BLA28 comparison: audited development result
